title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on the Time Limit for Payment of Various Social Insurance Pooling Funds after Bankruptcy of Enterprises That Implement Social Insurance

articles.content_en:
Supreme People's Court
Reply on the Issue of the Time Limit for Payment of Various Social Insurance
Pooled Funds after the Bankruptcy of Enterprises Participating in Social Insurance
Fa Fu [1996] No. 17
Higher People's Court of Sichuan Province:
We have received your High Court's Sichuan Gao Fa (1995) No. 167 "Request for Instructions on the Time Limit for Payment of Various Social Insurance Pooled Funds after the Bankruptcy of Enterprises Participating in Social Insurance." Upon study, the reply is as follows:
If an enterprise participating in social insurance becomes bankrupt, the overdue social insurance pooled funds shall be paid up to the date on which the People's Court declares the bankruptcy by a ruling.
This reply is given.
November 22, 1996
